terms.gloss: late at night, when the night was far gone
terms.comment: multus is at home in phrases of time; “till late at night” is ad multam noctem (see till late at night).

sources: Lewis & Short: nox
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections and the note on quantity words, checked against the editions named there.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 351.

phrases.latin: in Albānum meum multā nocte pervēnī
phrases.english: I reached my Alban house late at night
